sum.m: before, forward, forth: Greek and Latin pro
gather, read; send; or law: Latin legere, lēgāre or lēx; in legomorphic, Greek and Latin legō, I gather
a Greek ending: a thing being done. A phenomenon is a thing appearing; a prolegomenon, a thing being said first

mean: what is said beforehand: a formal introduction to a study. Greek prolegein, to say before; more than one are prolegomena. Prologue is its plainer twin: pro + logue
